gaps.sentence: She cheered ___ when she heard the news.
gaps.explanation: cheer up = become happier (also transitive: cheer somebody up).

gaps.sentence: The caterpillar will turn ___ a butterfly.
These old boots are completely worn ___.
gaps.explanation: wear out = become thin/unusable through use.

gaps.sentence: Please hand ___ your essays by Friday.
gaps.hint: give to a person in authority
gaps.explanation: hand in = give work/documents to somebody in authority.

gaps.sentence: Feel free to drop ___ for a coffee any time.
gaps.explanation: drop in = pay a casual visit; drop off = fall asleep or deliver.

gaps.sentence: Her essay stands ___ from the rest of the class.
gaps.explanation: stand out = be easy to notice, be better/different.

gaps.sentence: She was brought ___ by her grandparents.
gaps.explanation: bring up a child = raise, educate them.
